introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: This consultation center helps users request consultations that match their learning goals and schedules, then review expert responses. Users should keep requests aligned with each consultation area and respect different situations.

rules.title: Usage Rules
items: Write requests and responses in the consultation area that best matches the topic and purpose.
Use respectful language and make it clear when you are sharing facts, opinions, or personal experience.
Check rights and visibility before sharing personal information, copyrighted material, or external content.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Behavior
items: Insults, hate speech, harassment, threats, or behavior that prevents others from participating
Spam, repeated requesting, misleading information, malicious links, or harmful files
Publishing personal information, impersonation, unauthorized material, or encouragement of illegal activity

enforcement.title: Reporting and Enforcement
enforcement.body: If a consultation request appears to violate policy, report it through the reporting feature or contact channel. Operators may review the content and apply actions such as hiding requests, requesting edits, or limiting access to protect consultation quality.
